faqs.q: Sec. 38-306.5. - Self-service displays, vending machines prohibited.
faqs.a:
The display for sale of tobacco products or nicotine products by means of a self-service
               display by any business other than a smoking business as defined herein is prohibited.
               The owner, operator, manager, or other person who controls any business, other than
               a smoking business as defined herein, that sells tobacco products or nicotine products
               shall not permit the display for sale of any such products by means of a self-service
               display. No business, including any smoking business, may sell tobacco products or
               nicotine products by means of any vending machine.
(Ord. No.
4773
, § 4, 8-16-2021)
